item.text: The import path is stricter than the JSON format needs to be: it requires `version` to be the first property. I’m changing that to validate the same fields regardless of order, while retaining strict checks for the actual data. I’ll also store the game name in the snapshot and restore it into the name field on load; older snapshots will still load with a blank name.
